name: Arnold Geulincx
biography: Discussed as the first of Descartes's followers to abandon the pineal-gland theory of mind-body interaction, proposing instead the 'two clocks' theory (occasionalism), in which mind and body run independently in perfect pre-established correspondence without genuinely acting on one another.
